item.title: GTA 6's 30 FPS Console Target: A Technical Deep Dive
item.description: GTA 6 targets 30 fps on consoles at launch, sparking debate. We explore Rockstar's rationale, technical challenges, and the future of high-fidelity gaming.

item.title: GTA 6 Launch Day Live Updates: Technical Deep Dive & Impact
item.description: Live coverage of GTA 6’s midnight launch, detailing the 212 GB download, required PS5 firmware, new dual‑protagonist mechanics, record‑breaking streams and broader industry impact.

item.title: GTA 6 Cheat Codes Locked Until Story Finish – Impact
item.description: Rockstar’s GTA 6 now hides cheat codes behind the full 91‑mission story and extra challenges, reshaping sandbox play and sparking debate among fans.

item.title: GTA 6 Heat System Redefines Police Chases and Player Identity
item.description: Rockstar’s GTA 6 adds a three‑layer Heat system that evolves the classic Wanted mechanic with color‑coded stars, tracking icons, and heat zones.

item.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Won’t Reach 60 FPS on PS5 Pro
item.description: Rockstar says GTA 6 will run locked at 30 fps on PS5 Pro due to CPU limits, despite 1440p rendering, ray‑traced shadows and near‑4K upscaling.

item.title: PS5 Pro Shortage Deepens as GTA 6 Looms: What It Means
item.description: The PS5 Pro faces a chronic shortage amplified by GTA 6 hype, chip scarcity, and soaring component prices, pushing retail prices past $1,500.

item.title: Sony Secures RAM Supply to Meet PS5 FY2026 Demand
item.description: Sony confirms enough GDDR6 RAM for its FY2026 PS5 forecast, easing “Ramageddon” worries as GTA 6’s November launch promises a holiday sales surge.
